Method of Attack: Using CSS attribute selectors to guess sensitive content inside HTML tags, including CSRF tokens and password strings, by running pattern matches on attribute values and exfiltrating data via HTTP requests to attacker-controlled servers
Brute-force guessing of attribute values one letter or multiple pieces at a time
Attack Vector: Injection of malicious CSS code into web pages
Indicators of Compromise: Requests to attacker-controlled URLs such as https://attacker.host/ZeroC00L
Server logs showing HTTP GET requests with partial attribute matches (e.g., /00, /0L, /Ze, /Z_, /ro, /oC, /_L, /er, /C0)
CSS attribute selectors targeting HTML attributes containing sensitive data
